bottom_line: The ratings mostly still stand on fundamentals, but tonight is midterm election day, oil is back near $98 and AMD reports after the close, all risks the worldview names. Four of six names sit in segments the worldview rates neutral, so only NRG and VRT are backed by an overweight call.
what_changed: Futures are flat to slightly lower: S&P -0.1%, Dow -0.8% (Apple's weak margin outlook), Nasdaq-100 +0.3% to +0.4% after entering a correction. Not a big move, but nobody is adding risk before the vote.
WTI is up 2.2% to about $98.5 on Middle East tensions, which touches the oil-and-rates risk in the worldview.
AMD reports Q3 after the US close tonight (about $13.1bn revenue expected); I found no reaction yet, so the read-through to chips is unknown.
ON Semiconductor's AI data-centre revenue rose 175% but its shares fell about 5% after hours: good prints are still being sold, as the worldview warns.

trust: 24 picks so far, 0 ratings graded (grading starts after 28 days), so there is no hit rate yet. Picks average +1.0% vs QQQ against -1.0% for SMH, which is too early to call skill.
if_buying: Overweight means a small starter position, not full size.
Prefer NRG and VRT, where rating and worldview agree; wait on MU, STX, ONTO and ASML.
